description: Console header: the real-time board's U0TXD, U0RXD and GND
notes: THREE pins: the one board's console pair and a ground. EN and IO0 are NOT available: the vendor's board definition accounts for every pin on the ESP32-S3-Matrix's two header rows (3 power + 17 GPIO) and neither appears. They exist on the board - IO0 under the BOOT button, EN on the reset circuit - but reaching them means soldering to the dev board. This is the THIRD line of defence: USB-Serial-JTAG through the tail USB-C slot first (which is why USB MIDI is opt-in), a reflash over the same port second, this header third. A corrupted BOOTLOADER ends the instrument; that is accepted
